entries.text: HEY ME～N！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_first_00

entries.text: 想听我讲解何谓灵魂的人！\n就是你们吗！？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_first_01

entries.text: 深情灵魂饶舌乐莱姆这名字呀，\n可是闻名世界的哦。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_01

entries.text: 居然敢把这么有名的我叫来，\n你真是个大人物，HAHAHA！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_02

entries.text: 既然得到了冠军的青睐，\n那么我也不好拒绝了！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_03

entries.text: 就用我的灵魂说唱！\n来给蓝莓的小家伙们\r\n上一课吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_04

entries.text: 拜托了！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 不是让你教说唱！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 你真会配合嘛！\n对战的课程也交给我吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_05

entries.text: 哪会是说唱，\n才不会那样！HAHAHA！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp01_05b

entries.text: 蓝莓流行\n双打对战呀。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_00

entries.text: 我之所以喜欢双打对战，\n是因为要思考的东西很多，很DEEP！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_01

entries.text: 当２只宝可梦的招式混搭起来时，\n那可是超SWAG的合奏！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_02

entries.text: 这样啊
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 真酷！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_select_02

entries.text: HAHAHA！你！\n真的听明白了吗！？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_03

entries.text: HAHAHA！\n你很懂行嘛！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_03b

entries.text: 要是双打比单打更流行的话，\n我的活动也能进行得更轻松。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_04

entries.text: 就让我把双打的技巧刻到\n蓝莓那些小家伙们的骨子里吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp02_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n喘口气，break一下吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_00

entries.text: 我很感谢你\n把我叫到了蓝莓来。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_01

entries.text: 我喜欢被小孩包围。\n因为这充满灵魂，能得到力量。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_02

entries.text: 你对于我喜欢小孩这件事\n感到很意外吗？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_03

entries.text: 很意外！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 没那回事
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_select_02

entries.text: HAHAHA！别人经常这样说我！\n毕竟我的样子也很炫嘛！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_04

entries.text: HAHAHA！我看上去\n像个温柔的奶奶吗？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_04b

entries.text: 以前我并不擅长与小孩相处，\n但自从有了孙子之后，\r\n就变得十分喜欢小孩了。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_05

entries.text: 一看到和我孙子\n差不多大的你们努力的样子，\r\n我就忍不住会热泪盈眶。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_sp03_06

entries.text: HAHAHA！\n伤感的蓝调可不适合我呀。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_01_00

entries.text: 让我们来一场合奏！\n振作起精神吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_01_01

entries.text: 要来进行宝可梦交换吗？\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]ａ．ｋ．ａ冠军。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_01_02

entries.text: 我会推出DJ MUZAIGOU！\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你呢？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_01_03

entries.text:
你的判断！让我SO FUN！
搭配很赞！感谢交换！\c
我要竭尽全力培育它，
好让它能在双打对战大显身手！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]你要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n和我的MUZAIGOU交换吗？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_02_03

entries.text:
１只宝可梦？
交换不可能♪\c
同行不落单，
才能来交换♪[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_03_00

entries.text: 怎么啦，不交换了吗！？\n你要再多配合我一点哦！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_03_01

entries.text: 要来和我进行宝可梦交换吗？\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]ａ．ｋ．ａ冠军。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_trade_04_00

entries.text: 是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你呀？\n是想来和我一起演出吗？[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_talkto_00

entries.text: 灵魂对决，不如一别？\n火速放弃，我好丧气！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_cancel_00

entries.text: 哈！这可是你说的哦！\n让我们的灵魂混搭起来吧！！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battlestart_00

entries.text: 我专攻双打对战！\n想和我合奏的话，\r\n就带上２只以上的宝可梦吧！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battlestart_01

entries.text: HAHAHA！好啊～！\n我深深地感受到了你的灵魂！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 我会支持你的哦。\n虽然不能给你什么特别的关照。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 你想要我为巡演制作的运动鞋吗？\n穿上去意外地舒服哦。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 这可是稀罕货，\n到你进坟墓那天也要带着哦。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从莱姆那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]幽灵运动鞋[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_reward_00

entries.text: 你的妙语简直是SWAG！\n连地狱都为之震撼！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 等你灵魂高昂时就再来找我吧！\n拜拜，宝贝！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
HAHAHA！
你喜欢我的演出吗？\c
要是你想再次和我一起演出，
我会把你邀请到最前排的！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
我有一首
叫《GHOST FATHER》的代表作，
你听过这首乐曲吗？\c
歌词是我在
给父亲扫墓时想到的。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
入口那儿的对战场
挺不错嘛。\c
周围都是观众席，
应该也能用来做演出。[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
你可不要干坏事
让泰姆姐为难哦！\c
她要是被惹怒了
会比我更可怕哦！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]！
真是很积极啊！\c
在我唱歌的时候，
它还会配合我助兴呢！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_03

entries.text: DJ MUZAIGOU过得还好吧！？\c\n你给它听音乐的话，\n它就会开心地跳舞哦！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
我从也慈那里听说，
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！你……\c
把我提名为
你最喜欢的道馆馆主了！？\c
哼！居然有向我
表达好感的怪家伙！\c
……但！这可是
来自你的认可。
我就老实地收下你的心意吧！[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: coach_gym_ghost_randomtalk_sp
